instance.basis: FICTIONAL. A single employee reports (moderate credibility, uncorroborated) receiving a sympathetic direct-message approach referencing their public grievance posts about the firm, followed by an offer of paid 'consulting.' The approach has not visibly taken hold; the recruiter's target set inside the organization appears to be narrowing but no cooperation, access grant, or capability is established. Held at the type band pending corroboration and determination of what access the pitched employee holds.
